claims.text: The target materials are multicomponent high-entropy alloys in high-temperature solid and liquid states.
The proposed intervention integrates high-throughput screening, multiscale modeling, and experimental validation.
The integrated intervention will improve the accuracy of thermodynamic-property determination relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The integrated intervention will improve the availability of thermodynamic-property data relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The integrated intervention will improve the efficiency of thermodynamic-property determination relative to current experimental and computational methods.
The intervention will improve determination of melting temperature.
The intervention will improve determination of enthalpy and entropy of fusion.
The intervention will improve determination of volume change upon melting.
The intervention will improve determination of liquid thermodynamic properties.
Phase composition mediates the effect of the integrated intervention on thermodynamic-property determination.
Lattice distortion mediates the effect of the integrated intervention on thermodynamic-property determination.
Dislocation motion mediates the effect of the integrated intervention on thermodynamic-property determination.
Deformation twinning, FCC-to-HCP transformation, and cross-section reorientation interact synergistically.
Local lattice distortion impedes dislocation motion.
The cited deformation and dislocation mechanisms cause improved determination of melting and liquid thermodynamic properties.
The approach is applicable across a large compositional space.
The approach is limited to unspecified particular composition and temperature ranges.
Kinetic effects may influence the thermodynamic-property results.
The hypothesis can be tested by comparing integrated-method predictions with experimental measurements and current-method results.
Failure to improve accuracy, availability, and efficiency relative to current methods would falsify the hypothesis.
